name: B10-0412/2025 (The Left) – 10th anniversary of the detention of jailed Swedish publisher Gui Minhai in China
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the 10th anniversary of the detention of jailed Swedish publisher Gui Minhai in China
part_text:
The European Parliament calls for the release of Gui Minhai, a Swedish publisher held in China since October 2015. He was sentenced to 10 years in 2020 after a closed-door trial. The Parliament says his detention place is unknown, he has had no family or consular contact, and his health is reported to be worsening. It asks China to respect fair trial rights, medical care, family contact and consular access. This is an opinion; it does not change any law.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. Parliament only states demands and asks China to act.
- **Who it affects:** Gui Minhai, his family, and Sweden and the European Union.
- **What happens next:** The resolution is sent to European Union leaders, member states and China's government.
